en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad urban square with tram tracks in the pavement, lined by bare winter trees. In the center background stands a large, three‑story neoclassical building with arched ground‑floor windows and symmetrical rows of upper windows, likely a civic or railway‑related building. On the left is a row of buildings and a high, glass‑roofed hall resembling a railway station. People in early‑20th‑century European clothing—men in long coats and hats, women in long dresses and hats—walk and stand along the sidewalks and near tall streetlamps.
